messages:
maya: Heads-up marketing wants a compact pricing experiment next week: add an inline 'Price Estimator' widget, refresh middle tier name, and tweak a couple FAQ bullets. Aim = fewer Contact Sales clicks and higher self-serve signups. Who can take copy, embed, analytics, routing? don: I'll build the embed. Prefer a lightweight JS widget so we can capture locale/currency and fire a webhook client-side. Prototype snippet: ```html
``` Will expose window.RWPriceEstimator.init({el:'#rw-price-estimator', onSubmit: fn}) callback. irene: I'll own the FAQ/tier copy. Suggest new tier names for the middle tier: Launch / Scale / Enterprise (experiment uses 'Scale' -> 'Momentum' variant). Also CTA test: baseline 'Get started' vs test 'Estimate your monthly bill'. kevin-sales: Routing asks: if estimated_monthly_usd >= 7000 OR user selects 'Enterprise interest' -> AE queue. Also want a boolean 'webinar_invite' when estimate >= 15000 to auto-invite to a follow-up webinar. Please surface estimated_segment (self-serve/mid-market/enterprise). sam: Analytics: event prefix rwi_ (to avoid collisions): rwi_estimator_open, rwi_estimator_submit, rwi_estimate_value_usd, rwi_contact_cta. Payload should include estimated_monthly_usd, tier_variant, currency, locale, utm_source, anonymous_id. I'll map to BigQuery table marketing.rwi_pricing_estimates_v1 and add an alert if rwi_contact_cta increases by >20%. don: Timeline: can get widget to staging by Tue afternoon, QA Wed, experiment live Thu. Will include hidden fields for estimated_MRR and utm tags and POST to /webhooks/pricing-leads. kevin-sales: Confirmed routing thresholds. Also request a daily CSV dump of webhook leads for the experiment and a Slack digest of any estimate >= 25000. irene: FAQ notes I'll push: clarify rounding, currency limits (USD first), and a short line: "Estimates are indicative and non-binding; contact sales for custom quotes and reserved pricing." Legal approved similar wording last sprint. maya: Marketing asks: draft a short benchmark narrative for the launch post that emphasizes expected outcomes (Contact Sales down ~10-20%, signup lift ~+7-12%) and a webinar to recap findings + best-practices for cost control. I'll schedule the webinar for week 3 if experiment shows strong lift. sam: I'll finalize event names and BigQuery mapping today and share the analytics spec here. don: PR opened to staging: https://github.com/redwood-inference/marketing-site/pull/2789 by don deploy-bot: Staging build deployed: https://staging.redwood.ai/pricing-estimator (build-2026-11-03-211) maya: Thanks everyone. Run experiment for 21 days; primary metric = pricing CTA -> signup conversion. Secondary = Contact Sales click rate. If anything spikes ping #eng-oncall and tag me. Closing thread. :tada:
